name: CLMS 10-daily FPAR

source.name: CLMS Fraction of Absorbed Photosynthetically Active Radiation v2.0 (300 m, 10-daily), via CDSE
source.license: Copernicus data and information policy (free, full and open access; attribution required)
source.provider: European Union, Copernicus Land Monitoring Service / Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem
source.limitations: Dekads carry nominal dates (10th, 20th, month-end). The most recent composites are near-real-time RT0 estimates that later RT1/RT2 revisions replace, so recent values can change; persistent wet-season cloud reduces the observations behind a composite.

description: Copernicus Land Monitoring Service version 2 global 300 m FPAR, read with range requests from Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem S3 and clipped to the deployment area. Backfills six months and checks daily for new or revised 10-daily composites.

destinations.name: Vegetation productivity (FPAR)
destinations.description: 10-daily fraction of absorbed photosynthetically active radiation (FPAR) at 300 m, a measure of vegetation productivity.
